entries.heading: None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made
ancestors: DIVISION C—DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2021
entries.text:
Sec. 9028.  None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made 
available by this Act may be used in contravention of the First 
Amendment of the Constitution.
    This division may be cited as the ``Department of Defense 
Appropriations Act, 2021''.
